notes: Eight complete direction headings: 85 visually reviewed rows; 66 accepted nonstop schedules (25 Delta, 41 ASA), 17 connections and two through-stop rows excluded. The triangle and p4 number ranges identify ASA. All accepted rows have no dated footnotes.
Blank means daily; X6 excludes Saturday; X7 excludes Sunday; X67 is weekdays only; 6 is Saturday only and 7 is Sunday only. Each physical leg retains its own frequency.

MCN–ATL 1434 is Sunday only and yields no movement during this Thursday–Saturday window. Saturday-only AGS–ATL 1225 departs after the window ends, also yielding none. Its ATL–AGS outbound 1225 is included because it departs before the window ends.

ATL–MCN 1238 and MCN–ATL 1233 each have one stop at Columbus. Only the individually printed ATL–CSG/CSG–MCN and MCN–CSG/CSG–ATL rows create physical legs. Seventeen connecting rows do not create nonstop flights.
ATL–CSG 1238 is 22:56–23:36; CSG–MCN 1238 is 23:45–00:15 next day, a nine-minute ground interval. MCN–CSG 1233 is 04:45–05:15; CSG–ATL 1233 is 05:30–06:09, a fifteen-minute ground interval.
ATL–MCN 1436 is 15:16–15:56; return MCN–ATL 1436 departs 16:10, a fourteen-minute ground interval. Original crops confirm these non-round minutes.

ATL/AGS/CSG/MCN all use winter UTC−5. Printed noon token 1200n means 12:00. The star on ATL–AGS 312 indicates an off-peak fare, not arrival the next day. Only accepted CSG–MCN 1238 has next-local-day arrival.
